description:
Your job can move on without you.

A few years ago, one of my managers — Cory — passed away unexpectedly.

About a week later, I had to post his job.

That moment forced me to realize something uncomfortable:

A paycheck provides income.
Assets provide security.

That’s when I started thinking differently about money, work, and long-term freedom.

Not because work is bad — work is honorable.

But life is short, and I wanted to build a system where my family's future didn’t depend entirely on a job.

That’s what Paycheck to Portfolio is all about.

In this video I walk through:
• the Cory story and why it changed my thinking
• a full portfolio update
• how I think about growth, compounding, and portfolio cash flow
• the Paycheck Replacement Calculator I built
• how dividend income can gradually replace a paycheck
• the tools and resources inside the Paycheck to Portfolio community

This channel documents my real journey turning a W-2 paycheck into a portfolio designed to generate income.

Not overnight.

But steadily.

Assets replacing income.

What I Teach on This Channel
• dividend investing
• high-yield ETFs
• covered call ETFs
• portfolio income strategies
• financial independence (FIRE)
• living out of a brokerage account
• reinvesting dividends and compounding assets
• turning W-2 income into portfolio cash flow

If you're trying to build assets that eventually replace your paycheck, you're in the right place.
